items.source:
Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the sine of a value that is measured in radians.
Use sinhOf("angle", DEGREES) as shortcut for 
{ $sinh : { $degreesToRadians : "$angle" } }
.
items.translation:
创建一个新AggregationExpression，用于计算以radians（弧度）为单位的值的正弦。
可使用sinhOf("angle", DEGREES)作为以下操作的快捷方式： 
{ $sinh : { $degreesToRadians : "$angle" } }
